## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S3. This is audit backlog UX-26 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /consult/:id/note/print · doctor.
Findings and reviewers: F-27 · reviewer A-16, lead arbiter.
Rationale: The print shows identity and the note sections but not the nurse's vitals, the allergy, the coded diagnosis or the medicines; vitals enter only if the doctor pressed Add to Objective. The legal record of the visit may be thinner than the doctor believes. The page has no h1 (the only axe finding on 615 pages).
Proposed UX behaviour: The print of a signed note includes, by default and from what was recorded at signing: vitals with their time and source, the allergy state in words (recorded, not recorded, or no known allergies), coded diagnoses, and the medicines authorised in that visit by reference to the prescription. It has a page heading with clinic, doctor and licence line. The signed note itself is not edited: the print reads the signed version and the data linked to it at signing; anything added later appears only through an addendum.
Prototype and blueprint reference: None.
Components and tokens affected: NotePrintPage and the server PDF (QuestPDF) if the note has one. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Back end and front end.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None in code.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: question 9 of the validation plan (what the visit record and the printed prescription must contain), recorded on the issue with a date.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low to medium: signed records are immutable; the print must never show data newer than the signature without saying so.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) The prescription print (its own sign-off, #1097). (2) Editing a signed note.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a signed note for a visit with nurse vitals, a penicillin allergy and a coded diagnosis, when it is printed, then all three are on the print with their sources
- [ ] **AC2.** Given allergies not recorded at signing, when the note is printed, then it says not recorded and never none
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a vital corrected after signing, when the note is printed, then the print shows the value as at signing, and the test fails if later data replaces it silently
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the print view at five widths, when axe runs, then there is no violation and the page has one h1
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the issue, when it is closed, then it holds the pilot doctor's dated agreement on the contents
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when the print renders, then it mirrors and prints on A4 at 200 % zoom without loss

## Test notes

- Integration: print content reads the signed version.
- Playwright (tests/e2e/consult-note.spec.ts; J2 step 12): print holds vitals, allergy and diagnosis; axe.
